issue.body:
<!-- Please use this template while reporting a bug and provide as much info as possible. Not doing so may result in your bug not being addressed in a timely manner. Thanks!-->

##### Environment
<!-- Describe your setup. Versions of Node.js, Go etc. are needed only from developers. -->

```
Installation method:
Kubernetes version:
Dashboard version:v1.10.0
Operating system:  Ubuntu 18.04
Node.js version ('node --version' output): v11.10.0
Go version ('go version' output): go1.11.4
```

##### Steps to reproduce
<!-- Describe all steps needed to reproduce the issue. It is a good place to use numbered list. -->
`ng xi18n --out-file source.xlf`
##### Observed result
<!-- Describe observed result as precisely as possible. -->
Similar issue as observed. https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/13796
`Could not mark an element as translatable inside a translatable section ("mage's default entrypoint command. You can use the command options to override the default.
       [ERROR ->]<a href="http://kubernetes.io/docs/user-guide/containers/"
          target="_blank"
          tabi"): /home/phoenix/go/src/github.com/kubernetes/dashboard/src/app/frontend/create/from/form/template.html@295:8`
##### Expected result
<!-- Describe expected result as precisely as possible. -->
Successfully generated translation file.
##### Proposed Solution
<!-- If you have any comments or more details, put them here. -->
We can make a different component for the `Learn more Hyperlink Button` for the docs reference so we can escape the nested attribute translation. It is yet to be experimented :P that it works in that case or not, but it should work perfectly from my instinct.
We have this type of errors only in Learn more hyperlinks so we need only one component and we can reduce length of code that is repeating in `template.html`  

Related to #3574
